text:
maria: quick heads-up — a customer reported that the edge SDK is sending raw email addresses in telemetry for error reports.

sandeep: ugh, which flow? ingest or crash-reporting?

maria: ingest (client -> telemetry endpoint) when they opt-in to debug uploads. sample log: 
```
{"user_id":"u-12345","email":"alice@example.com","route":"/v1/generate","prompt_snippet":"Book a flight from nyc to sf"}
```

jess: so client-side wasn't stripping PII before attaching to the debug payload?

maria: seems like it — SDK had a recent change to include "context" blob for better repros. customers love it, but some fields leak.

lee: two quick ideas: 1) client-side sanitization config + allowlist fields; 2) server-side redaction layer that removes emails/phones before persisting.

sandeep: agreed. but server-side redaction is tricky for sampling + dedup. If we redact before checksum, sampling hotspots change.

timothy: can we pseudonymize instead? hash(email) with HMAC keyed by tenant-specific salt then store hash only. preserves dedup/identity while removing raw PII.

jess: HMAC sounds okay, but key management + rotation concerns. need to not make hashes reversible.

maria: proposal: client default = strip sensitive fields (email, phone, cc), opt-in allows pseudonymized values; server enforces never storing raw email. Also add telemetry policy flag in console per org.

sandeep: flow detail: 
- client sends payload (raw only if explicit opt-in)
- server ingest picks up header: `x-telemetry-privacy: strict|pseudonymize|raw`
- if strict => drop fields, if pseudonymize => hmac using org key from KMS; if raw => write but flag for retention review (enterprise only)

lee: how about sampling? we need to make sure sampling decisions are deterministic across redaction modes. My suggestion: compute sampling key from pseudonym/hash when available; otherwise fallback to route+request-id.

maria: good point. must document ordering: pseudonymize -> sampling -> persist. if client opted raw and server hmacs, sampling still deterministic.

timothy: need to add a migration plan: existing logs may contain emails. run an expunge job for last 30 days for orgs with strict policy enabled.

jess: UX for console: add per-org toggle + default = pseudonymize; show badge when any org has raw acceptance.

ops-bot: reminder: any change touching ingest must get security review and incidence plan. tag: @eng-security

sandeep: action items I can take: 1) draft ingest-side HMAC util + config knobs; 2) draft sampling key spec; 3) PR for server-side enforcement hooks.

maria: i'll draft the console toggle UI copy and the opt-in flow for SDKs.

lee: one more edge case — when customers paste long transcripts the email might be inside prompt. we should add a small NLP-based PII scrub on the SDK before sending debug payloads (lib size permitting).

jess: agree, keep it optional for mobile. desktop/Node SDKs enable by default.

maria: ok timeline? i'd like a canary in 2 weeks for pseudonymize mode + console toggle hidden behind feature flag.

sandeep: doable. i'll spike HMAC util this week.

deploy-bot: canary rollout queued once PRs merged and security sign-off obtained.

maria: thanks team. i'll create a follow-up doc with the exact headers and examples and link it here. :thumbsup:
